# poweradmin_zone_dnssec (Data Source)

Retrieves the DNSSEC signing status of a zone, with the DS records and DNSKEY needed for registry submission. Requires Poweradmin 4.5.0+ with the PowerDNS API configured.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read whether a zone is signed, with the DS records for the registrar
data "poweradmin_zone_dnssec" "example" {
  zone_id = 10
}

output "signed" {
  value = data.poweradmin_zone_dnssec.example.enabled
}

output "ds_records" {
  value = data.poweradmin_zone_dnssec.example.ds_records
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone_id` (Number) ID of the zone

### Read-Only

- `dnskey` (String) DNSKEY record content of the first key that carries DS records (the KSK or CSK); null when the zone is not signed
- `ds_records` (Attributes List) DS records of every key of the zone; empty when the zone is not signed (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ds_records))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the zone is DNSSEC signed
- `id` (String) The zone ID
- `presigned` (Boolean) Whether the zone is presigned (DNSSEC managed at the primary server)

<a id="nestedatt--ds_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ds_records`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (Number) DNSSEC algorithm number
- `digest` (String) Digest
- `digest_type` (Number) Digest type (2 = SHA-256, 4 = SHA-384)
- `key_tag` (Number) Key tag
